name: @splitsutra/functions
//build-order: Every script that runs tsc here builds @splitsutra/core first, because this package consumes core as a BUILT package: NodeNext resolves the bare specifier through core's exports map to packages/core/dist. The dependency is declared here rather than left to `pnpm -r`'s topological ordering so that running one script directly — `pnpm --filter @splitsutra/functions typecheck` on a clean clone, or firebase.json's predeploy hook — works without the caller having to know. Typecheck builds core too, not just compiles it: tsc needs core's .d.ts files, which only the build emits.
